title: Understanding and Analyzing Inappropriately Targeting Language in Online Discourse: A Comparative Annotation Study
reasoning: The study includes 'religion' and 'social belief' as primary target categories in its annotation framework. It specifically benchmarks and evaluates the ability of human annotators and ChatGPT to identify and categorize language targeting religious groups (e.g., Christians and Muslims) and social beliefs, including detailed analysis of agreement scores for these categories.
